prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1014; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the blue sedan that was involved in the parking lot incident.

Q: That's fine, we can note you as the claimant. Can you tell me where the collision happened?

A: It was in a grocery store parking lot in League City, Texas. I was backing out of a space near the entrance.

Q: What happened next?

A: I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything, so I started reversing slowly. Then I felt an impact on the rear passenger side. A pickup truck was coming down the aisle much faster than I expected.

Q: Were you moving when the impact occurred?

A: Yes, I'd say I was going maybe three or four miles an hour. I had just started to turn the wheel.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the time?

A: My wrist hurt right away. I grabbed the steering wheel to brace myself and I knew something was wrong. I went to the urgent care clinic that afternoon and they took x-rays.

Q: What did the medical staff tell you?

A: They said the wrist was fractured. I've got a cast on it now and I'm supposed to see a specialist next week to check on healing.

Q: Did you see the other driver's vehicle before the impact?

A: Not until it was almost on top of me. I didn't have a clear sightline between the parked cars.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm right-handed and this is making it hard to do everyday tasks. I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
